'''Nathan Price''' (born '''Matthew Sussman''') is a voice actor for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Price is one of the original voice actors on Pokémon. He was hired by [[Michael Haigney]] because Haigney's then-girlfriend worked at the New York Theatre Workshop, where Price was a performer in a play.<ref> Haigney, Michael. "Ep. 2 Pokémon Emergency." ''Original Pokéman'', Buzzsprout, 23 Mar 2022. [https://originalpokeman.buzzsprout.com/1663597/10305025-ep-2-pokemon-emergency https://originalpokeman.buzzsprout.com/1663597/10305025-ep-2-pokemon-emergency], 10:46–11:22.</ref> He played the original voice of Meowth from {{TRT}}. However, after about thirty episodes, he left that role and was replaced by [[Maddie Blaustein]]. He continued to play other minor characters through [[S05|season five]]. After that point, he left the series.
